# Financial Clarity Diagnostic

> Free 3-minute finance diagnostic for growing U.S. businesses. Scores books, cash visibility, forecasting, systems, and profitability. Educational tool — not personalized financial, tax, or legal advice. Optional consult with Visari Financial.

- Site: https://financialclaritydiagnostic.com/
- Partner: https://visarifinancial.com
- Audience: U.S. owners roughly $500k–$10M who have outgrown bookkeeping
- Not for: startups hunting a dashboard; companies with a sitting finance team

Diagnostic answers stay on the device unless the owner requests a consult. Google Search does not use llms.txt; this card is for LLM crawlers that look for it.
